instruction: `werkzeug.serving.run_simple(hostname, port, application, ...)` takes the WSGI application third, unlike most WSGI servers. Change its signature so the application comes first: `run_simple(application, hostname, port, use_reloader=False, ...)` (every parameter after `port` keeps its name, default and order). Update every caller of `run_simple` to the new order.
notes: Seeded 2026-10-05 on the current tip (no upstream fix exists). Gold = AST rewrite of every positional call (3rd arg moved first) plus >>> docstring examples. 12 of 15 gold files are examples/ scripts no test imports.
